heading: The Magi didn’t *travel alone.*
lede: There’s always room for one more. Christmas is the easiest invitation of the year. Pick a service, tweak the message, and send it to a friend, neighbor, or coworker.
message: Hey! I’m going to Christmas at Christ Community Church on {service}. It’s one hour, really relaxed, with carols and candlelight. Want to come with me? {link}
textPageLede: Tap the button, and your invite is already written. Just pick a friend and hit send!
textPageMessage: Hey! I’m going to Christmas at Christ Community Church and would love for you to come with me. Christmas Eve services are Wednesday, December 23, at 6:00 PM, and Thursday, December 24, at 2:00, 4:00, and 6:00 PM. Here are the details: {link}
